{"metadata":{"description":"Langfuse-style trace viewer for pi-agent — local-first, zero-setup, single-file HTML","id":"gh:1264888983","install_available":false,"language":"Python","name":"pi-trace-extension","slug":"npxcnency-ux/pi-trace-extension","topics":["agent","dsh-plugin","langfuse","llm","observability","pi","pi-agent","pi-package","trace","tracing"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Langfuse-style trace viewer for pi-agent — local-first, zero-setup, single-file HTML"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"### Experimental: Langfuse-style local trace viewer for pi-agent"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**pi-trace-extension reorganizes a pi-agent session from a *conversation* view into an *execution* v"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"iew.** pi's own `session.jsonl` is message-oriented — replayable, but flat. This extension subscribe"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"s to pi's lifecycle events and rebuilds them as a tree of *how the agent actually progressed* — ever"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"y LLM call, every tool execution, every sub-agent, with timing, token cost, and outcome — written to"},{"id":"p3s5","text":" disk as it happens."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Two artifacts are produced per session:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **`events.jsonl`** — machine-readable, append-only event stream
- **`trace.html`** — a self-contai"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ned, single-file, Langfuse-style viewer (zero external assets, opens in any browser)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Everything stays on your machine."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| pi's built-in `session.jsonl` | pi-trace-extension |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Conversation view (messages in order) | Execution view (steps + tools + sub-agents as a tree) |
| "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"One artifact (`session.jsonl`) | Two artifacts: `events.jsonl` (machine) + `trace.html` (human) |
| "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"Per-message metadata | Per-step latency, tokens, cost, stop reason, full LLM payload |
| Tool calls "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"inline as messages | Tools as siblings of `llm-generation` inside a `turn` (Langfuse-style) |
| No s"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"tatus semantics | `aborted` / `error` / `ok` distinguished and color-coded |
| Sub-agent runs collap"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"sed into a tool result | Sub-agent gets its own nested trace (turns / steps / tools) plus a click-th"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"rough link from the parent |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> 中文文档见 README.zh.md"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"You don't pick the install path. pi places it under `~/.pi/agent/npm/pi-trace-extension/` and auto-l"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"oads on every start. Coexists with any other pi extension."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Use pi normally — events are streamed to disk in the background."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Render the HTML report at any time:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Output:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| File | Description |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| `~/.pi/agent/traces/<session-id>/trace.html` | Single-file viewer, opens in default browser |
| `~"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"/.pi/agent/traces/<session-id>/events.jsonl` | Machine-readable event stream (append-only) |
| `~/.p"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"i/agent/traces/<session-id>/subagents/<child-id>/` | Nested directory per sub-agent — same `events.j"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"sonl` + `trace.html` layout, linked from the parent's sub-agent node |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"`trace.html` is also auto-generated on `session_shutdown` (without opening the browser), so closing "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"pi normally always leaves a viewable report."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## What you see in trace.html"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"A three-pane Langfuse-style viewer. **Single HTML file, no CDN, no fonts loaded from the network, no"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"Langfuse-style viewer. **Single HTML file, no CDN, no fonts loaded from the network, no analytics.**"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Pane | Content |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| **Top bar** | Session id (click to copy), counts (interactions / generations / tool calls), total "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"cost & duration |
| **Left tree** | Hierarchy: `session → interaction → turn → llm-generation + tool"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"` (siblings inside a turn). Click any node to inspect. Search box filters by name / tool / prompt. |"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"
| **Right detail** | For the selected node: badges (latency / token in→out / cost / model / stop re"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"ason), then sections — Input (full LLM payload as a foldable JSON tree with line numbers), Output, T"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"ool Calls, Error / Aborted (color-coded), Metadata. |
| **Bottom-left DAG stats** | Per-tool counts "},{"id":"p26s7","text":"in `ok/total · N ⏹` form (`bash 76/80 · 3 ⏹`). Red border for errors, yellow for aborts. |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Specific affordances:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **`aborted` vs `error` vs `ok`** — distinguishes user-cancelled (`⏹` yellow) from real errors (`❌`"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" red). 429 retries that eventually succeed are correctly classified as `ok`.
- **"Only errors" filte"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"r** — a toggle in the tree toolbar keeps only `error` / `aborted` nodes and their ancestor path, so "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"long sessions collapse to just the failing branches. Combines with the text search box (AND). Disabl"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ed on error-free sessions.
- **Sub-agent has its own trace** — when an agent spawns a sub-agent (sin"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"gle / parallel / chain), the child writes its own `events.jsonl` under `subagents/<child-id>/` and g"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"ets its own rendered `trace.html`. The parent's sub-agent-result node shows the child's turns / step"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"s / tools inline (rebuilt from messages) and offers an "Open child trace" button to jump into the ch"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"ild's full report. Parallel sub-agents are matched to their on-disk traces by sessionId where availa"},{"id":"p28s10","text":"ble.
- **Auto-retry detection** — when a turn re-enters with the same `turnIndex` (e.g. framework re"},{"id":"p28s11","text":"tried after a 429), the second occurrence is labeled `turn N (retry #1)` instead of collapsing the t"},{"id":"p28s12","text":"wo into one node.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## What it doesn't do"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Three categories — separated because they imply different mitigations."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"**By design (explicit choices, not failures)**"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **No network code.** Not anonymized usage, not crash reports, not telemetry "to improve the produc"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"t." If you want one of those, fork it.
- **No automatic prompt scrubbing.** Only key-name redaction "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"(`password`, `token`, `secret`, `api_key`, `authorization`, `bearer` → `***REDACTED***`) is applied "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"at write time. Your raw prompts, tool args, tool outputs, and model responses are stored verbatim.
-"},{"id":"p32s5","text":" **No team sharing UI.** This is single-user, single-machine. If you outgrow that, Langfuse self-hos"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"ted is the natural next step — the data model is intentionally similar.
- **No built-in retention/ro"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"tation.** `events.jsonl` grows monotonically per session. Long sessions can reach tens of MB; render"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"ed `trace.html` may be slow above 5 MB."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"**Structural (won't be fixed by better code)**"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- **`/trace` requires Python 3.8+.** The renderer is a Python stdlib script, intentionally — no Node"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"-side rebuild step, no bundler. If you can't have Python, this isn't for you.
- **Tied to pi's event"},{"id":"p34s3","text":" stream.** A different agent framework would need its own capture layer."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"**Privacy ceiling**"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- **Trace data is sensitive by default.** Prompts, tool args, and model outputs may all contain PII "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"/ secrets that don't match the redaction regex. If you intend to share a `trace.html`, **review it m"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"on't match the redaction regex. If you intend to share a `trace.html`, **review it manually first.**"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- pi-agent ≥ 0.79.x
- Node ≥ 18 (extension runtime)
- Python ≥ 3.8 (renderer; override with `PI_TRAC"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"E_PYTHON=/path/to/python3` if needed)"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"No other dependencies. Renderer uses Python stdlib only; viewer uses no JS framework."}],"truncated":true}
